messages:
Alice: quick kickoff  I'm assembling the changelog and release notes for the docs push. Scope: adaptive routing feature announce, migration guide for pinned variants, and snippet parity across py/ts/go/rust/cli. Need: updated examples, migration checklist, one-line Known Issues with repro steps, and l10n-friendly bullets.
Ben: i'll take Rust + CLI examples. any PR link to comment on?
Alice: PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5077 on branch release/docs-adaptive-routing-sync. drop comments there.
Cara: heads-up: runtime param `retry_policy` -> `fallback_policy` and the shape changed to an object. i'll update TS + Go samples.
Ben: Rust sample updated to show object form (serde map). quick example pushed in PR comments: ```rust
let resp = client.generate("kestrel-1", prompt, Some(json!({"fallback_policy": {"type": "model_variant", "priority": ["fast","cheap"]}})));```
Dave: l10n note: keep changelog bullets short and avoid idioms. i'll extract keys and add simplified english strings in a follow-up commit.
Ben: swapped raw githubusercontent links for docs permalinks and switched absolute paths to `/en/latest/` where appropriate. pushed commit.
Cara: migration checklist draft (4 short steps) in the migration doc bottom: 1) update pinned variant mapping in catalog; 2) run routing tests in staging; 3) enable prefix cache for heavy-context routes; 4) monitor p99 + errors for 24h.
Alice: need a tight Known Issues one-liner + repro. suggested: "p99 spikes on mixed long+short bursts; repro: stage, send one long context (>=4k tokens) then 8 parallel short prompts." can someone compress to single short line for the release notes?
Ben: concise repro added to PR comment: "Repro: staging -> send one 4k+ token request followed immediately by 8 concurrent 16-32 token requests; observe p99 spike."
qa-bot: QA run scheduled for PR #5077 on staging tomorrow 09:00PT. Please ensure snippets run in the staging runtime.
docs-bot: Staging preview deployed for PR #5077: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/5077 — verify snippet rendering and anchors. :robot_face:
Dave: l10n keys pushed, removed casual phrasing (no "heads-up" etc.). please review.
Cara: small nit: Dedicated/reserved pools may affect fallback ordering; added a short callout in migration notes to warn enterprise customers.
Alice: timeline: merge target EOD tomorrow. please add approvals in the PR once QA + l10n checks pass. i'll schedule the docs publish + product announcement post-merge. :tada:
